title: Battle of Haengju
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Haengju", at revision 1370265139, opens: "The Battle of Haengju took place on 14 March 1593 during the 1592–1598 Japanese invasion of Korea. The Japanese attack failed to overcome the fortress Haengjusanseong." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q279611, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1593 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
